question: What becomes of one who continually sees and worships the body as Shiva?
premises: One may see and worship the body day and night.
Such practice leads to becoming Shiva-natured.
The practitioner rests satisfied in the universal self-body and is established in its sign.
inference: Continuous vision and worship of the body as Shiva establish one in Shiva-nature and universal satisfaction.
plain_english: Seeing and worshipping the body day and night, one becomes of Shiva-nature. Such a person is satisfied, resting in the body as the universal self and established in its sign.
